description: Given a selector for nonempty subsets of A and an ordinal that cannot inject into A, the bounded recursive listing has a first marker; its preceding values biject that initial segment onto A.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.choiceListing_exhausts.{u} {α : Type u} (h : Ordinal.{u}) (hh : ¬Nonempty (h.ToType ↪ α))
  (s : (B : Set α) → B.Nonempty → α) (hs : ∀ (B : Set α) (hn : B.Nonempty), s B hn ∈ B) :
  have f := Lemmatheca.SetTheory.recursiveValue (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.choiceListingRule h s);
  ∃ l,
    f l = none ∧ (∀ b < l, f b ≠ none) ∧ (Function.Injective fun b => f ↑b) ∧ (Set.range fun b => f ↑b) = Set.range some
